data.name: Light and Dance VR - Music, Action, Relaxation
data.detailed_description:
Step into a world where music is all that matters. You are the one to decide how to play this game! Lay down and relax to watch the colors and patterns change to your music, dance until your feet are sore or challenge yourself in one of the music driven games.
Many amazing environments and dance floors are waiting for you to dance the night away!

Play your music, start the game, jump in and dance, relax or play some games. The visuals will blow your mind with depth and beauty and all driven by music!


We have big plans with this game!

Todays Features:

  • Radio stations build into the game.
  • Calory tracking while moving!
  • Supports every music source.
  • Jump interaction.
  • Microphone support!
  • Music visualizer, lean back, relax and enjoy!
  • Chillout-Mode supports laying, sitting and every imaginable, human possible position.
  • Many custom settings.
  • Great visuals!
  • Many music reactive Dance Floors to choose from!
  • Many Environments and Game-Modes -> more will come...
  • Realistic volumetric Lights and Fog.
  • Use your Touch-Controller for "drawing".
  • Change through Environments and Dance-Floors with the Touch-Controller.

Please vote for Light And Dance VR!


AND STAY TUNED!
Many great Updates are planned: Game Modes, Environments, Multiplayer? ;-)

Trailermusic:
OOOTHERSIDE - This Time by Mike B. Fort

Available for Arcades on SpringboardVR

reviews.review:
Light and Dance VR - Music, Action, Relaxation offers a refreshing take on virtual reality entertainment by combining music visualization, casual interaction, and stress-free gameplay into a single immersive experience. Developed by Hermann Fischer and published by Total Creations, the game focuses less on traditional objectives and more on allowing players to enjoy music through interactive environments filled with colorful lighting effects and responsive visuals. Instead of presenting a competitive rhythm challenge, it encourages users to create their own experience by dancing, relaxing, exploring, or simply enjoying the atmosphere while their favorite songs come to life in virtual reality.

One of the game's standout features is its ability to work with the player's personal music collection. Rather than restricting users to a fixed soundtrack, it allows virtually any music source to become part of the experience, giving every session a unique identity. The inclusion of internet radio stations further expands the listening options, making it easy to jump into the experience even without preparing playlists in advance. Because the visual effects react dynamically to whatever music is playing, each visit feels different depending on the chosen genre, whether it is energetic electronic music, soothing ambient tracks, classical compositions, or modern pop songs.

Visually, the game delivers an appealing collection of dance floors and immersive environments filled with animated lighting, particle effects, fog, and vibrant color displays. These visual elements synchronize with the music to create an ever-changing spectacle that feels particularly engaging inside a VR headset. Rather than striving for realism, the presentation embraces a stylized aesthetic that enhances the feeling of being inside a living music visualizer. The shifting lights and rhythmic environmental effects help create an atmosphere that can feel energetic during upbeat songs or peaceful during slower, more relaxing tracks.

Gameplay is intentionally open-ended, allowing players to interact with the virtual world in several different ways. Players can dance freely, move between environments, jump around the stages, draw using VR controllers, or simply stand still and enjoy the audiovisual presentation. One particularly thoughtful inclusion is the Chillout Mode, which is designed for maximum comfort by allowing players to experience the visuals while sitting or reclining. This flexibility makes the game approachable for users looking for a calming virtual escape as well as those interested in a more active dance session.

The experience also incorporates light fitness elements by tracking calories burned during movement. While it does not offer the structured workouts or precision-based mechanics found in dedicated VR rhythm games, it encourages natural physical activity without placing pressure on performance or scoring. Players who simply want to move to music at their own pace may find this relaxed approach more enjoyable than games that demand perfect timing and constant concentration.

Customization plays an important role throughout the experience. Numerous settings allow players to adjust the presentation to their personal preferences, while microphone support and multiple environment options further enhance replayability. The interface remains straightforward and easy to navigate, making the software accessible even for newcomers to virtual reality. Its emphasis on simplicity ensures that users can begin enjoying the experience almost immediately without spending time learning complicated mechanics or systems.

Despite its strengths, Light and Dance VR is not designed for players seeking deep progression, competitive leaderboards, or complex gameplay systems. The lack of structured objectives means that much of the long-term enjoyment depends on the player's appreciation for music, experimentation, and relaxation. Those expecting an action-heavy rhythm title may find the experience somewhat limited, while players looking for an interactive music visualizer or a calming VR environment will likely appreciate its more laid-back design philosophy.

Overall, Light and Dance VR - Music, Action, Relaxation successfully carves out its own niche by blending music, immersive visuals, gentle physical activity, and customizable environments into a relaxing virtual reality experience. Its greatest strength lies in the freedom it gives players to enjoy music however they choose, whether by dancing, exercising lightly, or simply unwinding in a colorful digital world. Although it lacks the depth and competitive elements of larger VR rhythm games, its versatility, accessibility, and immersive audiovisual presentation make it a worthwhile option for players seeking a unique and relaxing VR companion.

Rating: 7/10
